title: bolbitis × multipinna
intro: Bolbitis × multipinna, commonly known as the Bolbitis fern, is a hybrid plant species that combines the characteristics of Bolbitis heterocliton and Bolbitis glabra. The Bolbitis fern is valued for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and aiding in weight management. Its therapeutic actions include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its potential uses in traditional medicine. The plant contains bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
